# Slots

Vue components for what CSS cannot express. The list is closed. A theme ships one as `slots/<Name>.vue`; without the file, the core default in `app/theme/defaults/` renders. A slot is static by default and has no `<style>` block; declare `"island": true` under `slots` in `theme.json` when it needs JavaScript ([ADR 0005](../../adr/0005-theme-contract.md), section 12). Every slot may be an island. Guide: [../creating-a-theme.md](../creating-a-theme.md).

## `ThemeMark`

The site logo or wordmark, in the header and the footer.

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `number` | no | Height in px the core passes: 30 in the header, 56 in the `columns` footer, 32 in the `minimal` footer. |
| `context` | `'header' \| 'footer'` | no | Where the mark is rendered. |

- Core default: The site name as text (`aria-hidden`).

## `ThemeHero`

Art of the `showcase` home hero. The core renders it twice, each with its own box set by the caller's class.

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `compact` | `boolean` | no | False: the full art, 760 x 720 px from 1024px up. True: the compact box, 390 x 300 px below the copy on smaller screens. |

- Core default: An empty decorative `div` (`aria-hidden`); the caller's class gives it the hero art's box.

## `ThemeDivider`

Decoration inside the `columns` footer, between the link columns and the credits.

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `placement` | `'footer'` | no | Where it renders; the core only renders it in the footer. |

- Core default: Nothing.

## `ThemeEmptyState`

Wrapper of an empty state (no articles, no results). It receives the accent of its picture as the `--empty-accent` custom property, which is unset in the blog list's empty state: fall back, for example `var(--empty-accent, var(--accent))`.

No props.

- Core default: A `div` around the default slot content.

## `ThemeIllustration`

Illustration of a category on the topic cards of the home guide and of topic blocks.

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `category` | `Category` | yes | The category slug; `categoryColor(category)` gives its color role. |
| `size` | `number` | no | Width in px; the core passes 200. |

- Core default: Nothing.

## `ThemeProgressMarker`

Marker that travels along the reading-progress bar of an article, inside `bd-progress`; the slot renders its own `bd-progress-track` lane.

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `progress` | `number` | no | Reading progress, 0 to 100. |

- Core default: Nothing; the header's progress bar alone remains.

## `ThemeSupportArt`

Art of the support section. It renders inside the cup's `aria-hidden` SVG (`viewBox="0 0 120 100"`), so it returns SVG elements only.

No props.

- Core default: Nothing; the cup stays as it is.
